title: Move official KiCad libraries as one coherent Release Set
rationale: Symbols, footprints, and 3D packages move together at one compatible release tag and exact commits. Prefer adopting a coherent system installation read-only, and do not invent an exact tag when local provenance cannot prove it.

title: Never use editable working copies as installed releases
rationale: Fetch and validate exact revisions in staging, install releases immutably, and activate through an atomic pointer or configuration change with rollback. Never check out another tag in place beneath KiCad; defer activation whenever editor cleanliness cannot be proven.

name: LibraryRepo is the seam for reading and writing a client's library
description: Seed kicad-parts-ab30. LibraryRepos::repo_for(team) gives a LibraryRepo: can_read, copy_or_fetch, can_write, latest_commit, read_file and list_files, offline from the app's copy. Problems come back as RepoProblem: one plain line, git's words as details, and offline. kicad-parts-e9a3 scans through read_file and list_files; kicad-parts-02fb adds commit on a branch and push here.
A test's own git status in the person's clone refreshed .git/index, so a check that the app never writes there failed. git may write the index even for read-only commands.
resolution: Read a person's checkout with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 (library_repos/checkout.rs). In tests, compare the index's time before any git status of the test's own.

description: On Windows, connecting to a closed port on 127.0.0.1 takes about 2 seconds, because Windows retries the connection. A git test with a 2-second time limit timed out instead of saying 'Connection refused'.
resolution: Give a refused-port test a time limit well over 2 seconds. Test the time limit itself with a local listener that takes connections and never answers (library_repos/tests.rs).

title: Reach library repos with the person's own git and SSH setup
rationale: kicad-parts-ab30, ADR 0021, best judgement. The app runs the system git with no window, no input, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and a time limit that stops git with ssh. ssh gets BatchMode and ConnectTimeout only without the person's own SSH command. One no-checkout full clone per normalised address, shared by teams. Access: ls-remote, then push --dry-run.

title: Library repo review: no passwords, folders lead to bare repos, quiet start
rationale: Review of kicad-parts-ab30, ADR 0021. Addresses with a password are refused. A clone, as a path or file://, leads to its remote. Fetch and push use the team's own address under the copy's lock. At start: fetch only, two per host, no credential window or askpass; last results kept in library-repos.json.

description: git before 2.48 records no origin/HEAD after cloning an empty repo, so guessing the main branch by name picked the alphabetically first branch.
resolution: Run git remote set-head origin --auto after each fetch, and read only refs/remotes/origin/HEAD (library_repos/repo.rs record_main_branch).

title: Library source profiles say where a repo keeps its libraries
rationale: kicad-parts-e9a3, ADR 0022, best judgement. A profile lists a repo's libraries by nickname and repo path, model folders, path variables and their folders, .kicad_dbl files and a short prefix. Our layout is SourceProfile::own(), the only place symbols/, footprints/, 3d-models/ and GITPLM_PARTS are spelled out. Never rename a client's nicknames; the prefix is for the app only.

name: Scan a library repo, review once, follow the main branch
description: kicad-parts-e9a3. layout/scan.rs is one pure function over list_files and a batch read of tables, footprints and small files. Nicknames come from repo lib tables, else file names. A variable's folder is the one matching the most links. Reviewed layouts live in library-layouts/<repo>.json; a newer commit with the same scan fingerprint moves silently, else the row asks to review again.
